correctness.rationale: For a singled-out isolated vertex, its other n-1 points are i.i.d. uniform on the complementary arc of length a=1-2r. Their pair circular distance cannot wrap through the excluded arc because |U-V|<=a<1-r, so the conditional edge probability is 1-((a-r)/a)^2 for r<=1/3 and 1 otherwise. Thus E[EI]=n a^(n-1) C(n-1,2)p and E[E]E[I]=n^2(n-1)r a^(n-1), proving exact covariance formula for every n>=2 and 0<r<1/2. Its polynomial Q_n=-4+(3n+10)r-8nr^2 for r<=1/3, plus the linear second branch, determine zero/sign intervals; checked n=2..5 negative, n>=6 two thresholds including junction n=6 r+=1/3. Independent symbolic rational/algebra checks and dense 501-radius sample for n=2..15 corroborated exact identities and signs. Expansion of Q root r-=4/(3n)+8/(27n²)+... and r=c/n yields cov(E,I)/n→(1/2)e^-2c c(3c-4). No independent-edge approximation or Poissonization is used.
